title: Elixir of Hill Giant Strength
summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to raise Strength to at least 21 until your next Long Rest, or throw it as an Action to grant the effect in a 3 ft radius for 10 turns. Either use replaces other elixir effects on affected creatures.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. One dose raises your Strength to 21 until your next Long Rest if your Strength is lower. Replaces active elixir effects on affected creatures.
fields.Throw: Action. One dose affects all creatures in a 3 ft radius, including enemies, for 10 turns. Replaces active elixir effects on affected creatures.
fields.Strength: Raises a lower score to 21. A higher score stays higher.
fields.Stacking: Replaces other elixir effects on affected creatures. Another elixir can overwrite this effect.
fields.Crafting: Mix Salts of Hill Giant Fingernails with any Suspension. Extract three Hill Giant Fingers to learn the recipe.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Creative use: Drink before an encounter that relies on Strength, or group allies for a shared throw while keeping enemies outside the splash.

changes: Added reviewed BG3 drinking and throwing modes, Strength floor, elixir replacement, recipe and pinned sources.
